This means that regardless of the correctness, completeness, or usefulness of the retrieved texts, LLMs can consistently integrate knowledge within model parameters and the re- trieved texts to generate texts that are more concise, accurate, and complete. To achieve it, we propose an information refinement training method named 140 INFO-RAG in an unsupervised manner, which is low-cost and general across various tasks.
